Toby production and model workflow note, October 19, 2026
documents.text: I build open-source projects and work on Wild Rebellion. There are hours of material on my YouTube channel. Making Lilly's content is also part of my work and a subject I want to discuss. I want to explain what we built and how we built it, including narrative descriptions of work whose repository is private. I do not want source code from a private repository published. I use OpenAI five five in this work. I now have access to Argon and we are using it for some things. My specific opinions about the models, exact roles for Argon, comparative performance, prices, and model-release availability are not supplied in this note and must not be invented. This is a firsthand workflow note, not a vendor product announcement.
